"""Evolvable cache replacement policy starting from LRU baseline."""

from collections import OrderedDict


class EvolvedCache:
    """Byte-based cache with evolvable replacement policy."""
    
    # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
    def __init__(self, capacity_bytes):
        self.capacity = capacity_bytes
        self.current_size = 0
        self.hits = 0
        self.misses = 0
        # ARC: T1 (recency) + T2 (frequency) + ghost lists B1, B2
        self.t1 = OrderedDict()  # recently accessed once
        self.t2 = OrderedDict()  # accessed more than once (hot)
        self.b1 = {}  # ghost of evicted T1: obj_id -> size
        self.b2 = {}  # ghost of evicted T2: obj_id -> size
        self.b1_order = OrderedDict()  # for LRU eviction of ghost entries
        self.b2_order = OrderedDict()
        self.t1_size = 0
        self.t2_size = 0
        self.t1_sz = {}
        self.t2_sz = {}
        self.p = 0  # target bytes for T1
        self.ghost_max = 5000  # larger ghost list for better adaptation

    def _evict_one(self):
        """Evict one item using ARC policy."""
        if self.t1 and (self.t1_size >= max(1, self.p) or not self.t2):
            eid, _ = self.t1.popitem(last=False)
            esz = self.t1_sz.pop(eid)
            self.t1_size -= esz
            self.current_size -= esz
            self.b1[eid] = esz
            self.b1_order[eid] = 1
            if len(self.b1) > self.ghost_max:
                old, _ = self.b1_order.popitem(last=False)
                self.b1.pop(old, None)
        elif self.t2:
            eid, _ = self.t2.popitem(last=False)
            esz = self.t2_sz.pop(eid)
            self.t2_size -= esz
            self.current_size -= esz
            self.b2[eid] = esz
            self.b2_order[eid] = 1
            if len(self.b2) > self.ghost_max:
                old, _ = self.b2_order.popitem(last=False)
                self.b2.pop(old, None)
        elif self.t1:
            eid, _ = self.t1.popitem(last=False)
            esz = self.t1_sz.pop(eid)
            self.t1_size -= esz
            self.current_size -= esz
            self.b1[eid] = esz
            self.b1_order[eid] = 1
            if len(self.b1) > self.ghost_max:
                old, _ = self.b1_order.popitem(last=False)
                self.b1.pop(old, None)

    def _evict_to_fit(self, obj_size):
        while self.current_size + obj_size > self.capacity and (self.t1 or self.t2):
            self._evict_one()

    def access(self, obj_id, obj_size):
        """Process an access request. Returns True for hit, False for miss."""
        # Hit in T1 -> promote to T2
        if obj_id in self.t1_sz:
            sz = self.t1_sz.pop(obj_id)
            self.t1.pop(obj_id)
            self.t1_size -= sz
            self.current_size -= sz
            self.t2[obj_id] = 1
            self.t2_sz[obj_id] = sz
            self.t2_size += sz
            self.current_size += sz
            self.hits += 1
            return True

        # Hit in T2 -> move to MRU
        if obj_id in self.t2_sz:
            self.t2.move_to_end(obj_id)
            self.hits += 1
            return True

        self.misses += 1
        if obj_size > self.capacity:
            return False

        # Ghost hit in B1: favor recency
        if obj_id in self.b1:
            ghost_sz = self.b1.pop(obj_id)
            self.b1_order.pop(obj_id, None)
            # Adapt p: increase by average object size ratio
            b1_len = max(1, len(self.b1) + 1)
            b2_len = max(1, len(self.b2))
            delta = ghost_sz * max(1, b2_len // b1_len)
            self.p = min(self.p + delta, self.capacity)
            self._evict_to_fit(obj_size)
            self.t2[obj_id] = 1
            self.t2_sz[obj_id] = obj_size
            self.t2_size += obj_size
            self.current_size += obj_size
            return False

        # Ghost hit in B2: favor frequency
        if obj_id in self.b2:
            ghost_sz = self.b2.pop(obj_id)
            self.b2_order.pop(obj_id, None)
            b1_len = max(1, len(self.b1))
            b2_len = max(1, len(self.b2) + 1)
            delta = ghost_sz * max(1, b1_len // b2_len)
            self.p = max(self.p - delta, 0)
            self._evict_to_fit(obj_size)
            self.t2[obj_id] = 1
            self.t2_sz[obj_id] = obj_size
            self.t2_size += obj_size
            self.current_size += obj_size
            return False

        # Cold miss -> admit to T1
        self._evict_to_fit(obj_size)
        self.t1[obj_id] = 1
        self.t1_sz[obj_id] = obj_size
        self.t1_size += obj_size
        self.current_size += obj_size
        return False
    # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
    
    def hit_rate(self):
        """Return the hit rate as a fraction."""
        total = self.hits + self.misses
        return self.hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0
